title: Gold Nisab Threshold
urdu: سونے کا نصاب 7.5 تولہ (تقریباً 87.48 گرام) ہے، جس پر ایک سال گزرنے کے بعد 2.5 فیصد زکوٰۃ واجب ہوتی ہے۔
english: The Nisab threshold for gold is 7.5 tola (approx. 87.48 grams), subject to 2.5% Zakat after one lunar year of possession.

steps.title: Wazan Ya Maliyat Darj Karein
steps.detail: Apne paas mojood sone ka wazan (tola ya grams mein) ya kul market value calculator mein darj karein.

steps.title: Nisab Aur 2.5% Hisab
steps.detail: Agar kul net zakatable assets نصاب tak puhanch jayein to 2.5% hissa nikal kar mustahiqeen ko dein.

steps.title: Qamri Saal Ki Takmeel
steps.detail: Yaqeen karein ke nisab ke barabar ya us se zyada maqdar par poora ek hijri (qamri) saal guzar chuka ho.

title: Silver Nisab Threshold
urdu: چاندی کا نصاب 52.5 تولہ (تقریباً 612.36 گرام) ہے، اور واجب شرح 2.5 فیصد ہے۔
english: The Nisab threshold for silver is 52.5 tola (approx. 612.36 grams), with a standard Zakat rate of 2.5%.

steps.title: Chandi Ki Miqdar Shamil Karein
steps.detail: Mojooda chandi ka wazan ya qeemat calculator mein shamil karein.

steps.title: Net Assets Ke Sath Jam'a Karein
steps.detail: Cash, savings aur trade inventory ke sath milakar vajibat (liabilities) minus karein.

steps.title: Mustahiqeen Tak Puhanchana
steps.detail: Hisab aane ke baad zakat ki raqam shar'i mustahiqeen tak jald aur amanat dari se puhanchayein.

title: Deductible Liabilities Rule
urdu: زکوٰۃ کا حساب لگاتے وقت واجب الادا قرض اور فوری واجبات کل قابلِ زکوٰۃ اثاثوں سے منہا کیے جاتے ہیں۔
english: When calculating Zakat, due debts and immediate obligations are deducted from total zakatable assets.

steps.title: Kul Zakatable Assets Jam'a Karein
steps.detail: Gold, silver, cash in hand/bank aur karobari maal ki qeemat jam'a karein.

steps.title: Qarz Minus Karein
steps.detail: Kul jama raqam mein se wajibal-ada qarz ghata kar baqi net amount par 2.5% nikal lein.

steps.title: Record Mehfooz Rakhein
steps.detail: Apni asset aur liability ki calculation note kar ke rakhein taake har saal ka hisab wazeh aur asan rahe.

title: Cash, Bank Savings Aur Prize Bonds / Investments
urdu: نقد رقم، بینک بیلنس، سیونگز اور قابلِ زکوٰۃ سرمایہ کاری کو نصاب کے ساتھ ملا کر 2.5 فیصد زکوٰۃ ادا کی جاتی ہے۔
english: Cash on hand, bank balances, savings, and zakatable investments are combined toward Nisab and taxed at 2.5%.

steps.title: Hath Ki Raqam Aur Bank Balances Jam'a Karein
steps.detail: Ghar mein rakhi naqd raqam, current/savings accounts aur kisi ke paas rakhi hui apni amanat ya wapsi wali raqam ka hisab lagayein.

steps.title: Nisab Ke Muqable Mein Check Karein
steps.detail: Agar aap ke paas sona ya chandi nahi hai to kul naqd raqam aur bachat ko silver ya gold nisab ki mojooda qeemat se muqabla karein.

steps.title: 2.5% Zakat Alag Karein
steps.detail: Saal mukammal hone par net zakatable raqam ka 2.5% hissa (ya 40th hissa) alag kar ke mustahiqeen mein taqseem karein.

title: Karobari Maal (Trade Inventory) Rule
urdu: جو پاکیزہ مال تم نے کمایا ہے اس میں سے خرچ کرو؛ فروخت کے لیے رکھا گیا کاروباری مال قابلِ زکوٰۃ ہوتا ہے۔
english: Spend from the good things which you have earned; goods held for sale in trade are subject to Zakat.

steps.title: Faroqht Ke Maal Ki Market Value Lagayein
steps.detail: Dukaan, godam ya online business mein jo maal munafe aur farokht ke liye rakha hai us ki zakat ke din ki mojooda market qeemat shamil karein.

steps.title: Fixed Assets Ko Alag Rakhein
steps.detail: Karobar ki imarat, machinery, gaadi ya zaati istemal ki cheezon par zakat nahi aati; sirf farokht wale maal aur karobari naqd/bataayon ka hisab karein.

steps.title: Karobari Qarz Minus Kar Ke 2.5% Nikalein
steps.detail: Suppliers ya karobari qarz ki fori raqam ghata kar baqi net karobari maaliyat par 2.5% zakat nikal lein.

title: Qamri Saal (Hawl) Aur Zakat Ki Tareekh
arabic: يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْأَهِلَّةِ قُلْ هِيَ مَوَاقِيتُ لِلنَّاسِ
urdu: لوگ آپ سے نئے چاند کے بارے میں پوچھتے ہیں؛ کہہ دیجیے کہ وہ لوگوں کے لیے وقت اور حج کے تعین کا ذریعہ ہیں۔
english: They ask you about the crescents. Say, they are measurements of time for the people.

steps.title: Apni Qamri Tareekh Tay Karein
steps.detail: Jis hijri tareekh ko aap ke paas pehli baar nisab ke barabar maal jama hua tha, us ko apni zakat ki salana tareekh ke taur par note karein.

steps.title: Darmiyani Kami Beshi Ka Usul
steps.detail: Agar saal ke darmiyan maal kam bhi ho jaye magar saal ke aakhir mein dobara nisab ya us se zyada ho jaye to zakat wajib hogi.

steps.title: Waqt Par Adaigi Ki Koshish
steps.detail: Taakhir karne ke bajaye saal poora hote hi hisab saaf kar ke zakat ada karein taake zimmedari waqt par poori ho.

title: Masarif-e-Zakat (Mustahiqeen Ke Haq)
urdu: بے شک صدقات (زکوٰۃ) صرف فقیروں، مسکینوں اور قرآن میں بیان کردہ مقررہ مصارف کے لیے ہیں۔
english: Zakat expenditures are only for the poor, the needy, and the designated categories specified in the Quran.

steps.title: Mustahiq Ki Pehchan Karein
steps.detail: Zakat un ghareeb ya zarooratmand afrad ya idaron ko dein jo shar'i taur par mustahiq hon; walidain, aulad aur miyan-biwi ko zakat nahi di ja sakti.

steps.title: Tamleek Ka Khayal Rakhein
steps.detail: Mustahiq ko maal ya raqam ka haqeeqi malik bana kar dein taake woh apni zaroorat ke mutabiq istemal kar sake.

steps.title: Qareebi Rishtedaron Ko Tarjeeh
steps.detail: Agar koi zarooratmand rishtedar (jaise bhai, behn, chacha ya phuphi) shar'an mustahiq ho to unhein dena zakat aur silah rehmi dono ka ajar deta hai.
